System.assertNotEquals(null, knowledge.getRecord()); System.assertEquals(true, knowledge.equals(knowledge)); System.assertEquals(null, knowledge.getId()); System.assertEquals(null, knowledge.getSourceId()); knowledge.selectDataCategory('x','y'); knowledge.setDataCategory('x','y'); System.assertNotEquals(null, knowledge.cancel()); System.assertNotEquals(null, knowledge.view()); ApexPages.StandardSetController standard = new ApexPages.StandardSetController(new List<Account>{new Account(Name='a')}); System.assertEquals(true, standard.equals(standard));
